description: Fork of exp097 (E=256, classic residual, no residual_lut, linear unembedder). out_proj is replaced with MultiHeadLut(n_heads=1, n_outputs=8, nap=8, tph=2048, return_per_table_outputs=True) followed by SparseScatter(tph=2048, n_sparse_outputs=8 -> n_outputs=E=256). Per-(head, table) random subsets of E without replacement. Decouples out_proj weights from E: now 1*2048*256*8 = 4.2M per layer (vs 1*1024*64*256 = 16.8M in exp097). All other modules (qk_joint, v_lut, classic skip residual, linear unembedder) unchanged.
